title: Service port set to one value then corrected to another
notes: Tests update/correction handling: the FIRST proposed port (8080) is explicitly reverted within the same session in favor of 7777, which conflicts with another service. Gold captures ONLY the final value plus a lesson about the correction, mirroring fx10's structure.

turns.text: Let's have the new metrics-exporter service listen on port 8080.
Setting metrics-exporter to listen on port 8080.
Wait, actually hold on — 8080 is already used by the admin-console service on the same box, that'll conflict. Let's use 7777 instead.
Good catch — switching metrics-exporter to port 7777 instead of 8080, since 8080 is already bound by admin-console on the same host and would fail to start.
Right, and just to be clear for anyone reading this later — 7777 is final, 8080 was a mistake we caught before it shipped.
Confirmed: metrics-exporter listens on port 7777. I'll make sure the config and docs reflect 7777, not the earlier 8080 that was never actually deployed.

gold_atoms.text: metrics-exporter listens on port 7777 — NOT the initially proposed port 8080, which was reverted before shipping.
Port 8080 was already bound by the admin-console service on the same host, so assigning it to metrics-exporter as well would have caused a startup conflict.
